SELECT t.name as tenant_name,
  jr.total_job_runs_2025,
  jr.failed_runs_2025,
  round(jr.failed_runs_2025 * 100.0 / jr.total_job_runs_2025, 1) as failure_rate_pct,
  round(jr.avg_duration_seconds_failed, 1) as avg_duration_seconds_failed,
  coalesce(o.total_orders_2025, 0) as total_orders_2025,
  case when coalesce(o.total_orders_2025, 0) = 0 then null
       else round(jr.failed_runs_2025 / o.total_orders_2025 * 1000.0, 1)
  end as failed_runs_per_1000_orders
FROM tenants t
JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id,
    count(*) as total_job_runs_2025,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') as failed_runs_2025,
    avg(duration_ms / 1000.0) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') as avg_duration_seconds_failed
  FROM job_runs
  WHERE queued_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND queued_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
) jr ON jr.tenant_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as total_orders_2025
  FROM orders
  WHERE placed_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY tenant_id
) o ON o.tenant_id = t.id
ORDER BY jr.failed_runs_2025 DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 20
note: avg_duration_seconds_failed is computed from job_runs.duration_ms/1000 (the only duration field available), averaged over failed runs only; failed_runs_per_1000_orders is left blank (NULL) when a tenant has zero 2025 orders, per the request.
